_comment: custom_voice_presets are used by CustomVoice models (speaker + instruct + language). voice_design_presets are used by the VoiceDesign model (instruct + language only, no speaker). Both are fully editable from the Custom Voice Presets / Voice Design Presets tabs on this engine's settings page -- this is the 'custom voice properties' system. Base-model voice cloning does not use this file; drop .wav + matching .reference.txt pairs into the voices/ folder instead.

custom_voice_presets.speaker: Ryan
custom_voice_presets.description: Example custom voice property: Ryan, angry

custom_voice_presets.speaker: Vivian
custom_voice_presets.instruct: Speak softly, as a hushed whisper.
custom_voice_presets.description: Example custom voice property: Vivian, whispering

voice_design_presets.instruct: A bright, friendly female assistant voice with a warm, moderate pitch and clear articulation.
A deep, calm male narrator voice, slow-paced and authoritative.
